head: b9aed02ac1cde907a06d04fdbd96568ca38b85a9
summary: Reproduction confirmed on Linux. With all controls passing, an explicit fl on a stored SortableTextField with maxCharsForDocValues=6 and useDocValuesAsStored=false returns 'apple ' (6 chars) instead of the stored 'apple pear orange': the DocValues substitution leaks the truncated sort value into the stored-field response. The neighboring useDocValuesAsStored path is unaffected. This validates the Windows side's source-derived hypothesis as a real defect (related SOLR-18592 / SOLR-8344 line). No fix was attempted and nothing was posted publicly; whether to open this as its own ticket or fold it into SOLR-18592 is the owner's call.
